summary.text: Martha Garcia is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico for House District 6 and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham (D) appointed her on February 26, 2025, to fill the seat of Rep. Eliseo Alcon (D) after his death, and she assumed office on February 27, 2025.
